name: Suzhou Shihua New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Shihua New Material Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of functional materials in China. The company offers functional electronic materials used in AI smart hardware, automotive electronics, and medical electronics for bonding, thermal conductivity, electrical conductivity, shielding, chemical resistance, and waterproofing inside electronic products. It also provides high-performance optical materials used in mainstream display panels, such as OLED and LCD. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
